# BPSC TRE 4.0 Composite Examination Master Blueprint & All-Subject Guide

## 1. Conducting Authority & Examination Scheme
- **Conducting Commission**: Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC), Patna.
- **Official Portal**: bpsc.bih.nic.in
- **Examination Structure**: Single Composite Paper of 150 Objective Questions (Total Marks: 150).
- **Duration**: 150 Minutes (2 Hours 30 Minutes).
- **Marking Scheme**: **+1.0 Mark** per correct answer, **0.0 Negative Marking** (No penalty for wrong answers).
- **Part I - Language Qualifying (भाषा - अर्हता)**: 30 Questions (English 8 Qs + Hindi/Urdu 22 Qs). Qualifying criteria: Minimum 30% marks (9 marks out of 30) required.
- **Part II - General Studies (सामान्य अध्ययन)**: 40 Questions (Elementary Math & Reasoning, General Science, Indian National Movement & Bihar History, Geography & Current Affairs).
- **Part III - Concerned Subject / Specialized Discipline & Pedagogy**: 80 Questions.

## 2. Core Syllabus Breakdown
1. **General Studies & Bihar Special GK**: 1857 Revolt in Bihar (Babu Kunwar Singh), Champaran Satyagraha 1917, Kisan Sabha (Swami Sahajanand Saraswati), Quit India 1942 (Patna Secretariat Martyrs, Azad Dasta), Ancient Magadha, Mauryas, Nalanda, Sher Shah Suri, River systems (Ganga, Kosi, Son), Soils, Census 2011, Saat Nischay-1 & 2 schemes.
2. **Language Qualifying (English & Hindi)**: English vocabulary, articles, prepositions, voice, narration, tenses; Hindi वर्ण विचार, स्वर व व्यंजन संधि, समास, तत्सम-तद्भव, कारक, काल, वाच्य, पर्यायवाची, विलोम, मुहावरे, वर्तनी व वाक्य शुद्धि।
3. **Elementary Mathematics & Reasoning**: Number system, divisibility, LCM/HCF, percentage, profit-loss, simple & compound interest, ratio, time & work, trains, mensuration 2D/3D, statistics (mean/median/mode), coding-decoding, series, blood relations, direction sense.
4. **General Science, Social Studies & Pedagogy**: Physics (motion, optics, sound, electricity), Chemistry (acids/bases, periodic table, metals), Biology (cells, human physiology, vitamins, genetics), Indian Constitution (Fundamental Rights, DPSPs, Article 32), Indian Geography, Inductive/Deductive pedagogy, NEP 2020.

## 3. High-Yield Question Bank Sample (600 Representative Questions)

**Q1 [bpsc-tre-general-studies-bihar-gk | ID: bpsc-tre-general-studies-bihar-gk-0001]**
- (EN): Who among the following was the legendary octogenarian leader who spearheaded the 1857 Revolt against the British in Bihar from Jagdishpur (Bhojpur)?
- (HI): 1857 के प्रथम स्वतंत्रता संग्राम में बिहार के जगदीशपुर (भोजपुर) से अंग्रेजों के विरुद्ध सशस्त्र विद्रोह का नेतृत्व करने वाले वीर योद्धा कौन थे?
- *Correct Answer*: **A** | *Marks*: 1.0

- (EN): Who persuaded Mahatma Gandhi during the 1916 Lucknow Session of the Indian National Congress to visit Champaran and investigate the plight of indigo ryots under the Tinkathia system?
- (HI): दिसंबर 1916 के भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के लखनऊ अधिवेशन में किसने महात्मा गांधी को चंपारण आकर तिनकठिया प्रणाली के तहत नीलहे किसानों के शोषण की जांच करने हेतु राजी किया था?
- *Correct Answer*: **B** | *Marks*: 1.0

- (HI): वर्ष 1929 में 'बिहार प्रांतीय किसान सभा' की स्थापना किसने की थी तथा 1936 में लखनऊ में 'अखिल भारतीय किसान सभा' के प्रथम अध्यक्ष कौन बने?
- *Correct Answer*: **C** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q4 [bpsc-tre-general-studies-bihar-gk | ID: bpsc-tre-general-studies-bihar-gk-0004]**
- (EN): On 11 August 1942, during the Quit India Movement, seven courageous young students were martyred by British police firing while attempting to hoist the National Flag on which historic building in Patna?
- (HI): भारत छोड़ो आंदोलन के दौरान 11 अगस्त 1942 को राष्ट्रीय तिरंगा फहराने के प्रयास में ब्रिटिश पुलिस की गोलीबारी से सात वीर छात्र किस भवन के मुख्य द्वार पर शहीद हुए थे?
- *Correct Answer*: **D** | *Marks*: 1.0

- (HI): नवंबर 1942 में दिवाली की रात हजारीबाग सेंट्रल जेल से भागने के उपरांत जयप्रकाश नारायण ने नेपाल की तराई में किस भूमिगत छापामार संगठन का गठन किया था?

- (HI): प्राचीन बिहार में बौद्ध दर्शन एवं उच्च शिक्षा के विश्व विख्यात केंद्र 'नालंदा महाविहार' की स्थापना किस गुप्त सम्राट ने की थी?

- *Correct Answer*: **D** | *Marks*: 1.0

- **Clear the Language Hurdle First**: Ensure securing at least 9 marks out of 30 in Part I language section.

- **Accuracy in Numerical Aptitude**: Formulas for CI-SI differences, mensuration and time-work ensure full marks.

# BPSC TRE Revision Bundle: Indian National Movement & Bihar Special GK

## 1. Historic Freedom Movements in Bihar
- **1857 Revolt in Bihar**: Babu Kunwar Singh (Jagdishpur, Bhojpur) led the uprising at age 80, capturing Arrah and defeating British forces under Captain Le Grand. Pir Ali Khan, a humble bookseller of Patna, led the initial uprising on 3 July 1857.
- **Champaran Satyagraha (1917)**: First civil disobedience movement by Mahatma Gandhi in India. Raj Kumar Shukla persuaded Gandhi at the 1916 Lucknow session to fight against the Tinkathia system (compulsory indigo planting on 3/20 of land).
- **Kisan Sabha Movement**: Swami Sahajanand Saraswati established the Bihar Provincial Kisan Sabha (BPKS) in 1929 and presided over the All India Kisan Sabha in Lucknow in 1936. Karyanand Sharma led the Bakasht movement at Barahiya Tal (Munger).
- **Quit India Movement (1942)**: On 11 August 1942, seven brave student martyrs were shot outside the Patna Secretariat gate while hoisting the tricolour. Jayaprakash Narayan escaped from Hazaribagh jail and founded the underground guerilla 'Azad Dasta' in Nepal.

## 2. Geography, Demographics & Bihar Economy
- **River Systems**: Ganga flows 445 km through 12 districts in Bihar. Kosi is known as the 'Sorrow of Bihar' due to westward meandering and devastating floods. Son originates at Amarkantak and joins Ganga near Danapur.
- **Protected Areas**: Valmiki National Park (West Champaran) is Bihar's sole Tiger Reserve. Kanwar Jheel (Begusarai) is an oxbow lake and Bihar's first Ramsar wetland site. Vikramshila Gangetic Dolphin Sanctuary is situated in Bhagalpur.
- **Census 2011**: Population density of 1,106 persons/sq km (highest in India). Overall literacy: 61.8% (Rohtas highest at 73.4%). Sex ratio: 918 (Gopalganj highest at 1,021).
- **Polity & Welfare**: Bihar was the first state in India to grant 50% reservation to women in Panchayati Raj (2006). Seven Resolves Part 2 (सात निश्चय-2: 2020-2025) includes Sashakt Mahila Saksham Mahila and Har Khet Tak Sinchai Ka Pani.

summary: Standard language qualifying guide with 150 sampled questions covering English grammar, prepositions, voice, narration, and Hindi वर्ण विचार, संधि, समास, तत्सम-तद्भव, कारक, काल, वाच्य, पर्यायवाची, विलोम एवं शुद्ध वर्तनी।
content:
# BPSC TRE Revision Bundle: Language Qualifying Part-I - English & Hindi Grammar

## 1. Qualifying Threshold
- **Total Questions in Exam**: 30 MCQs (Part I).
- **Minimum Qualifying Score**: 30% marks (9 marks out of 30). Qualifying is compulsory to evaluate candidate's main parts.

## 2. English Grammar Essentials
- **Subject-Verb Agreement**: 'Neither... nor' and 'Either... or' follow the number of the closer subject. Collective nouns acting as a unified unit take singular verbs.
- **Preposition Usage**: Proficient 'in', rely 'on', abstain 'from', different 'from', despite (no preposition 'of').
- **Voice & Narration**: Present perfect passive uses 'have/has been + V3'. Indirect speech for wh-questions does not take 'that'; question word acts as connective with affirmative subject-verb order.
- **Idioms & Vocabulary**: 'To burn the candle at both ends' (overworking), 'A blessing in disguise' (misfortune turning into advantage).

## 3. Hindi Vyakaran Key Concepts
- **वर्ण विचार**: क वर्ग (कंठ्य), च वर्ग (तालव्य), ट वर्ग (मूर्धन्य), त वर्ग (दंत्य), प वर्ग (ओष्ठ्य)। प्रत्येक वर्ग के 1, 3, 5 अल्पप्राण तथा 2, 4 महाप्राण।
- **संधि**: स्वर संधि के पांच भेद: दीर्घ (आ, ई, ऊ), गुण (ए, ओ, अर्), वृद्धि (ऐ, औ), यण (य्, व्, र्), अयादि (अय्, आय्, अव्, आव्)।
- **समास**: अव्ययीभाव (यथाशक्ति), तत्पुरुष (राजपुत्र), कर्मधारय (नीलकमल), द्विगु (चौराहा), द्वंद्व (माता-पिता), बहुव्रीहि (पीतांबर)।
- **कारक**: कर्ता (ने), कर्म (को), करण (से/के द्वारा), संप्रदान (को/के लिए), अपादान (से पृथक), संबंध (का/की/के), अधिकरण (में/पर), संबोधन (हे/अरे)।
- **मानक वर्तनी**: उज्ज्वल (उ-ज्-ज्-व-ल), कवयित्री (क-व-यि-त्री), आशीर्वाद (आ-शी-र्वा-द)।

## 4. High-Yield Question Bank Sample (150 Questions)

**Q1 [bpsc-tre-language-qualifying | ID: bpsc-tre-language-qualifying-0001]**
- (EN): In Hindi grammar, which rule of Swara Sandhi is applied in the formation of the word 'महोत्सव' (Mahotsav), and what is its correct split?
- (HI): हिन्दी व्याकरण में 'महोत्सव' शब्द का सही संधि-विच्छेद क्या है तथा इसमें स्वर संधि का कौन-सा भेद प्रयुक्त हुआ है?
- *Correct Answer*: **A** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q2 [bpsc-tre-language-qualifying | ID: bpsc-tre-language-qualifying-0002]**
- (EN): Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition: 'The candidate was thoroughly proficient _____ both spoken English and written Hindi.'
- (HI): दिए गए वाक्य में उपयुक्त Preposition का चयन कीजिए: 'The candidate was thoroughly proficient _____ both spoken English and written Hindi.'
- *Correct Answer*: **B** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q3 [bpsc-tre-language-qualifying | ID: bpsc-tre-language-qualifying-0003]**
- (EN): In which type of compound (समास) neither the first word (पूर्वपद) nor the second word (उत्तरपद) is principal, but together they point to a third unique entity, as in 'पीतांबर' (भगवान विष्णु)?
- (HI): जिस समास में कोई भी पद प्रधान न होकर दोनों पद मिलकर किसी तीसरे अन्य पद की ओर संकेत करते हैं (जैसे: पीतांबर - पीले हैं वस्त्र जिसके अर्थात श्रीकृष्ण/विष्णु), उसे कौन-सा समास कहते हैं?
- *Correct Answer*: **C** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q4 [bpsc-tre-language-qualifying | ID: bpsc-tre-language-qualifying-0004]**
- (EN): Identify the correct passive voice transformation of the sentence: 'The teacher has evaluated all the answer scripts.'
- (HI): दिए गए वाक्य का सही कर्मवाच्य (Passive Voice) रूप पहचानिए: 'The teacher has evaluated all the answer scripts.'
- *Correct Answer*: **D** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q5 [bpsc-tre-language-qualifying | ID: bpsc-tre-language-qualifying-0005]**
- (EN): According to Sanskrit and Hindi phonetics, which category of consonants are pronounced when the back of the tongue touches the soft palate/throat (कंठ), comprising 'क, ख, ग, घ, ङ'?
- (HI): हिन्दी वर्णमाला में 'क, ख, ग, घ, ङ' वर्णों का उच्चारण स्थान क्या है?
- *Correct Answer*: **A** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q6 [bpsc-tre-language-qualifying | ID: bpsc-tre-language-qualifying-0006]**
- (EN): Choose the grammatically correct option to fill in the blank: 'Neither the headmaster nor the assistant teachers _____ present at the staff meeting yesterday.'
- (HI): दिए गए रिक्त स्थान हेतु व्याकरण सम्मत विकल्प चुनिए: 'Neither the headmaster nor the assistant teachers _____ present at the staff meeting yesterday.'
- *Correct Answer*: **B** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q7 [bpsc-tre-language-qualifying | ID: bpsc-tre-language-qualifying-0007]**
- (EN): Identify the sentence containing a Transitive Verb (सकर्मक क्रिया) where the action directly transfers to an object (कर्म)?
- (HI): निम्न में से सकर्मक क्रिया (Transitive Verb) युक्त वाक्य का चयन कीजिए जिसमें क्रिया का फल कर्म पर पड़ता है:
- *Correct Answer*: **C** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q8 [bpsc-tre-language-qualifying | ID: bpsc-tre-language-qualifying-0008]**
- (EN): What is the precise meaning of the idiomatic expression 'To burn the candle at both ends'?
- (HI): अंग्रेजी मुहावरे 'To burn the candle at both ends' का सही अर्थ क्या है?
- *Correct Answer*: **D** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q9 [bpsc-tre-language-qualifying | ID: bpsc-tre-language-qualifying-0009]**
- (EN): In the sentence 'वृक्ष से पत्ते गिरते हैं' (Leaves fall from the tree), which case (कारक) is indicated by the prepositional marker 'से' denoting separation/detachment?
- (HI): 'वृक्ष से पत्ते गिरते हैं' वाक्य में अलगाव (पृथकता) दर्शाने वाले 'से' चिह्न में कौन-सा कारक है?
- *Correct Answer*: **A** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q10 [bpsc-tre-language-qualifying | ID: bpsc-tre-language-qualifying-0010]**
- (EN): What is the single word used to designate 'A person who collects, studies, or is fascinated by postage stamps'?
- (HI): वाक्यांश 'A person who collects, studies, or is fascinated by postage stamps' के लिए एक शब्द कौन-सा है?
- *Correct Answer*: **B** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q11 [bpsc-tre-language-qualifying | ID: bpsc-tre-language-qualifying-0011]**
- (EN): Identify the group consisting exclusively of Sanskrit-origin unmodified 'Tatsam' (तत्सम) words:
- (HI): निम्न में से केवल तत्सम (Tatsam) शब्दों का सही वर्ग कौन-सा है?
- *Correct Answer*: **C** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q12 [bpsc-tre-language-qualifying | ID: bpsc-tre-language-qualifying-0012]**
- (EN): Choose the correct reported/indirect speech form of: He said to me, 'Where are you going for your summer vacation?'
- (HI): दिए गए वाक्य का सही Indirect Speech रूप चुनिए: He said to me, 'Where are you going for your summer vacation?'
- *Correct Answer*: **D** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q13 [bpsc-tre-language-qualifying | ID: bpsc-tre-language-qualifying-0013]**
- (EN): Identify the grammatically correct and faultless sentence (शुद्ध वाक्य) from the options below:
- (HI): निम्न विकल्पों में से व्याकरण की दृष्टि से शुद्ध वाक्य का चयन कीजिए:
- *Correct Answer*: **A** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q14 [bpsc-tre-language-qualifying | ID: bpsc-tre-language-qualifying-0014]**
- (EN): Select the word that is most nearly OPPOSITE in meaning (antonym) to the underlined word: 'The author's arguments were so OBSCURE that few critics understood them.'

content:
# BPSC TRE Revision Bundle: Elementary Mathematics & Mental Ability Simulation

## 1. Core Mathematical Formulas
- **Commercial Arithmetic**:
  - CI - SI Difference for 2 years: D = P * (R/100)^2.
  - Successive Percentage Change: Net % = a + b + (ab/100)%.
  - Time & Work: If A completes in x days and B in y days, together they take (xy)/(x+y) days.
  - Relative Speed: Opposite directions = S1 + S2; Same direction = S1 - S2.
- **Mensuration & Geometry**:
  - Equilateral Triangle Area: (sqrt(3)/4) * a^2.
  - Trapezium Area: 1/2 * (a + b) * h.
  - Cylinder: Curved Surface = 2*pi*r*h, Total Surface = 2*pi*r*(r+h), Volume = pi*r^2*h.
  - Cone: Slant height l = sqrt(r^2 + h^2), Volume = 1/3 * pi*r^2*h.
  - Circle: Angle subtended by arc at center is twice the angle subtended at any point on the circle.
- **Statistics & Probability**:
  - Empirical Relationship: Mode = 3 * Median - 2 * Mean.
  - Probability: P(E) = (Favorable Outcomes) / (Total Outcomes), where 0 <= P(E) <= 1.

## 2. Reasoning & Mental Ability Shortcuts
- **Direction Sense**: Net displacement calculated via Pythagoras theorem D = sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2).
- **Linear Ranking**: Total = Rank from Left + Rank from Right - 1.
- **Clock Angle**: Angle = |30H - 5.5M| degrees. Hands coincide (0°) 11 times in 12 hours (22 times in 24 hours).
- **Calendar Odd Days**: Normal year has 1 odd day (365 mod 7 = 1); leap year has 2 odd days.

## 3. High-Yield Question Bank Sample (150 Questions)

**Q1 [bpsc-tre-mathematics-reasoning | ID: bpsc-tre-mathematics-reasoning-0001]**
- (EN): In a moderately skewed statistical distribution of examination marks, the Mean is 32 and the Median is 30. Using Pearson's empirical relationship, what is the Mode of the distribution?
- (HI): किसी परीक्षा प्राप्तांकों के बारंबारता बंटन में यदि माध्य (Mean) 32 और माध्यिका (Median) 30 है, तो कार्ल पियर्सन के आनुभविक संबंध के अनुसार बहुलक (Mode) क्या होगा?
- *Correct Answer*: **A** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q2 [bpsc-tre-mathematics-reasoning | ID: bpsc-tre-mathematics-reasoning-0002]**
- (EN): The difference between the Compound Interest (compounded annually) and Simple Interest on a principal sum of ₹10,000 for 2 years at an annual interest rate of 8% per annum is:
- (HI): ₹10,000 की मूलधन राशि पर 8% वार्षिक ब्याज दर से 2 वर्ष के लिए चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज (वार्षिक संयोजित) और साधारण ब्याज का अंतर कितना होगा?
- *Correct Answer*: **B** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q3 [bpsc-tre-mathematics-reasoning | ID: bpsc-tre-mathematics-reasoning-0003]**
- (EN): A can complete a piece of work in 12 days, while B can complete the same work in 18 days. If they work together, in how many days will the entire work be completed?
- (HI): A किसी कार्य को 12 दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है तथा B उसी कार्य को 18 दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है। यदि वे दोनों एक साथ मिलकर कार्य करें, तो संपूर्ण कार्य कितने दिनों में समाप्त होगा?
- *Correct Answer*: **C** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q4 [bpsc-tre-mathematics-reasoning | ID: bpsc-tre-mathematics-reasoning-0004]**
- (EN): In a circle with centre O, if the minor arc AB subtends an angle ∠AOB = 110° at the centre, what is the measure of the angle ∠APB subtended by the same arc at any point P on the remaining major circumference?
- (HI): केंद्र O वाले एक वृत्त में, यदि लघु चाप AB द्वारा केंद्र पर अंतरित कोण ∠AOB = 110° है, तो उसी चाप द्वारा शेष दीर्घ वृत्तखंड की परिधि पर स्थित किसी बिंदु P पर अंतरित कोण ∠APB का मान क्या होगा?
- *Correct Answer*: **D** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q5 [bpsc-tre-mathematics-reasoning | ID: bpsc-tre-mathematics-reasoning-0005]**
- (EN): Pointing to a photograph of a gentleman, Sunita says: 'His only brother is the father of my daughter's father.' How is the gentleman in the photograph related to Sunita's husband?
- (HI): एक सज्जन की तस्वीर की ओर इशारा करते हुए सुनीता कहती है: 'उसका एकमात्र भाई मेरी पुत्री के पिता का पिता है।' तस्वीर वाला सज्जन सुनीता के पति से किस प्रकार संबंधित है?
- *Correct Answer*: **A** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q6 [bpsc-tre-mathematics-reasoning | ID: bpsc-tre-mathematics-reasoning-0006]**
- (EN): A shopkeeper sells a book for ₹480 after allowing a discount of 20% on the marked price. If he still makes a profit of 20% on the cost price, what is the cost price of the book?
- (HI): एक दुकानदार एक पुस्तक के अंकित मूल्य पर 20% की छूट देकर उसे ₹480 में बेचता है। यदि उसे फिर भी क्रय मूल्य पर 20% का लाभ होता है, तो पुस्तक का क्रय मूल्य (Cost Price) क्या है?
- *Correct Answer*: **B** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q7 [bpsc-tre-mathematics-reasoning | ID: bpsc-tre-mathematics-reasoning-0007]**
- (EN): Two trains of lengths 140 m and 160 m are running in opposite directions on parallel tracks at speeds of 60 km/h and 48 km/h respectively. In how many seconds will they completely cross each other?
- (HI): 140 मीटर और 160 मीटर लंबी दो रेलगाड़ियां समानांतर पटरियों पर विपरीत दिशाओं में क्रमशः 60 किमी/घंटा और 48 किमी/घंटा की गति से दौड़ रही हैं। वे एक-दूसरे को पूरी तरह पार करने में कितने सेकंड का समय लेंगी?
- *Correct Answer*: **C** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q8 [bpsc-tre-mathematics-reasoning | ID: bpsc-tre-mathematics-reasoning-0008]**
- (EN): What is the digit in the units place of the product: (7^95 - 3^58)?
- (HI): व्यंजक (7^95 - 3^58) के परिणाम में इकाई का अंक (Unit Digit) क्या होगा?
- *Correct Answer*: **D** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q9 [bpsc-tre-mathematics-reasoning | ID: bpsc-tre-mathematics-reasoning-0009]**
- (EN): Given Statements: I. All teachers are scholars. II. Some scholars are poets. Which Conclusions logically follow?
Conclusions: 1. Some poets are scholars. 2. All teachers are poets.
- (HI): दिए गए कथन: I. सभी शिक्षक विद्वान हैं। II. कुछ विद्वान कवि हैं।
निष्कर्ष: 1. कुछ कवि विद्वान हैं। 2. सभी शिक्षक कवि हैं। कौन-सा निष्कर्ष तार्किक रूप से निकलता है?
- *Correct Answer*: **A** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q10 [bpsc-tre-mathematics-reasoning | ID: bpsc-tre-mathematics-reasoning-0010]**
- (EN): If the radius of the base of a right circular cylinder is doubled and its height is halved, what will happen to its volume?

**Q11 [bpsc-tre-mathematics-reasoning | ID: bpsc-tre-mathematics-reasoning-0011]**
- (EN): In a certain code language, if 'TEACHER' is coded as 'VGCEJGT', how will 'STUDENT' be coded in that same language?

**Q12 [bpsc-tre-mathematics-reasoning | ID: bpsc-tre-mathematics-reasoning-0012]**
- (EN): In what ratio must a merchant mix Darjeeling tea costing ₹280 per kg with Assam tea costing ₹210 per kg to obtain a blended tea worth ₹250 per kg?

**Q13 [bpsc-tre-mathematics-reasoning | ID: bpsc-tre-mathematics-reasoning-0013]**
- (EN): A school teacher walks 15 meters North, turns right and walks 20 meters, turns right again and walks 15 meters, and finally turns left and walks 10 meters. How far and in which direction is the teacher now from the initial starting point?

# BPSC TRE Revision Bundle: General Science, Social Studies & Teaching Pedagogy

## 1. General Science Key Concepts
- **Physics**: Myopia (near-sightedness) is corrected with diverging concave lenses. Sound waves are longitudinal mechanical waves that travel fastest in solids. Rocket propulsion applies Newton's Third Law and momentum conservation.
- **Chemistry**: Plaster of Paris is Calcium Sulfate Hemihydrate (CaSO4·1/2H2O), made from gypsum (CaSO4·2H2O). Baking soda is Sodium Hydrogen Carbonate (NaHCO3). Galvanization protects iron with a protective coating of zinc.
- **Biology**: Mitochondria is the powerhouse of the cell, synthesizing ATP. Photolysis of water releases oxygen during photosynthesis. O Rh-negative blood is the universal donor. Vitamin C deficiency causes Scurvy.
- **Ecology**: Lindeman's 10% law states only ~10% energy transfers to consecutive higher trophic levels. Montreal Protocol (1987) protects stratospheric ozone by phasing out CFCs.

## 2. Indian Constitution & Geography
- **Polity**: Article 32 (Constitutional Remedies) is the 'Heart and Soul' of the Constitution. Article 44 mandates Uniform Civil Code (UCC). Fundamental Duties (Article 51A) were added by the 42nd Amendment (1976) upon Swaran Singh Committee's recommendation. Habeas Corpus writ protects personal liberty against unlawful detention.
- **Geography**: Regur (Black) soil derived from basaltic lava is ideal for cotton. Hirakud Dam is built on the Mahanadi River in Odisha. The Tropic of Cancer passes through 8 states and does NOT pass through Bihar.

## 3. Educational Pedagogy & Teaching Aptitude
- **Teaching Methods**: Kilpatrick formulated the Project Method based on purposeful social learning. Inductive method moves from concrete examples to abstract rules.
- **Evaluation & CCE**: Continuous and Comprehensive Evaluation assesses cognitive, affective and psychomotor domains using formative and summative tools.
- **NEP 2020**: Implements the 5+3+3+4 curricular structure (Foundational 5, Preparatory 3, Middle 3, Secondary 4), prioritizing mother tongue instruction up to Class 5.

## 4. High-Yield Question Bank Sample (150 Questions)

**Q1 [bpsc-tre-general-science-social-science | ID: bpsc-tre-general-science-social-science-0001]**
- (EN): A school teacher notices that a student can clearly see nearby objects on their desk but struggles to read the blackboard from a distance. Which vision defect does the student have, and which corrective lens is prescribed?
- (HI): एक शिक्षक देखता है कि एक विद्यार्थी अपनी डेस्क पर रखी पुस्तक को स्पष्ट पढ़ लेता है परंतु दूर श्यामपट्ट पर लिखे अक्षरों को पढ़ने में असमर्थ है। विद्यार्थी किस दृष्टि दोष से पीड़ित है और इसके निवारण हेतु किस लेंस का चश्मा दिया जाता है?
- *Correct Answer*: **A** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q2 [bpsc-tre-general-science-social-science | ID: bpsc-tre-general-science-social-science-0002]**
- (EN): What is the chemical name and correct chemical formula of 'Plaster of Paris' (POP), widely used for setting fractured bones and making statues?
- (HI): टूटी हड्डियों को स्थिर करने और मूर्तियां बनाने में प्रयुक्त होने वाले 'प्लास्टर ऑफ पेरिस' (POP) का रासायनिक नाम और सही रासायनिक सूत्र क्या है?
- *Correct Answer*: **B** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q3 [bpsc-tre-general-science-social-science | ID: bpsc-tre-general-science-social-science-0003]**
- (EN): Which cellular organelle is designated as the 'Powerhouse of the Cell' (कोशिका का ऊर्जा गृह) because it generates adenosine triphosphate (ATP) via aerobic cellular respiration?
- (HI): किस कोशिकांग को 'कोशिका का ऊर्जा गृह' (Powerhouse of the Cell) कहा जाता है क्योंकि यह कोशिकीय श्वसन द्वारा एटीपी (ATP) के रूप में जैव ऊर्जा उत्पन्न करता है?
- *Correct Answer*: **C** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q4 [bpsc-tre-general-science-social-science | ID: bpsc-tre-general-science-social-science-0004]**
- (EN): Which Article of the Constitution of India was characterized by Dr. B.R. Ambedkar as the 'very soul of the Constitution and the very heart of it', empowering citizens to move the Supreme Court for enforcement of Fundamental Rights?
- (HI): डॉ. बी.आर. अंबेडकर ने भारत के संविधान के किस अनुच्छेद को 'संविधान की आत्मा और उसका हृदय' (Heart and Soul of the Constitution) कहा था, जो मौलिक अधिकारों के प्रवर्तन हेतु सर्वोच्च न्यायालय जाने का अधिकार देता है?
- *Correct Answer*: **D** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q5 [bpsc-tre-general-science-social-science | ID: bpsc-tre-general-science-social-science-0005]**
- (EN): According to Raymond Lindeman's 10% Ecological Law of energy transfer, how much energy is transferred from one trophic level to the next consecutive higher trophic level in an ecosystem food chain?
- (HI): रेमंड लिंडमैन के 10% ऊर्जा नियम के अनुसार, किसी पारिस्थितिक तंत्र की खाद्य श्रृंखला में एक पोषण स्तर से अगले उच्च पोषण स्तर पर लगभग कितने प्रतिशत ऊर्जा स्थानांतरित होती है?
- *Correct Answer*: **A** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q6 [bpsc-tre-general-science-social-science | ID: bpsc-tre-general-science-social-science-0006]**
- (EN): Which soil type, formed by the weathering and denudation of basaltic lava rocks of the Deccan Traps, is intensely fertile, moisture-retentive, and acclaimed as ideal for cotton cultivation?
- (HI): दक्कन के लावा पठार (बेसाल्ट चट्टानों) के अपक्षय से निर्मित कौन-सी मिट्टी सर्वाधिक जल-धारण क्षमता युक्त तथा कपास की खेती के लिए विश्व प्रसिद्ध है जिसे 'रेगुर' (Regur) मिट्टी भी कहा जाता है?
- *Correct Answer*: **B** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q7 [bpsc-tre-general-science-social-science | ID: bpsc-tre-general-science-social-science-0007]**
- (EN): Which experiential pedagogical method, formulated by William Heard Kilpatrick (a disciple of John Dewey), defines learning as 'a purposeful activity proceeding in a social environment'?
- (HI): जॉन डीवी के शिष्य विलियम हर्ड किलपैट्रिक द्वारा प्रतिपादित कौन-सी शिक्षण विधि सीखने को 'सामाजिक वातावरण में पूर्ण संलग्नता से की जाने वाली सोद्देश्य गतिविधि' के रूप में परिभाषित करती है?
- *Correct Answer*: **C** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q8 [bpsc-tre-general-science-social-science | ID: bpsc-tre-general-science-social-science-0008]**
- (EN): In physics, sound waves propagating through air are classified as which type of waves, and how does their propagation velocity change as medium density and elasticity increase from gases to liquids to solids?
- (HI): भौतिक विज्ञान में वायु में संचरित होने वाली ध्वनि तरंगें किस प्रकार की तरंगें हैं, और गैसों से द्रवों तथा ठोसों में जाने पर ध्वनि का वेग किस प्रकार परिवर्तित होता है?
- *Correct Answer*: **D** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q9 [bpsc-tre-general-science-social-science | ID: bpsc-tre-general-science-social-science-0009]**
- (EN): A student tests four unknown solutions A, B, C, and D with universal pH paper and records pH values of 2, 7, 9, and 13 respectively. Which solution represents a strong acid?
- (HI): एक विद्यार्थी यूनिवर्सल पीएच पेपर से चार अज्ञात विलयनों A, B, C और D का परीक्षण करता है और उनके पीएच मान क्रमशः 2, 7, 9 और 13 पाता है। इनमें से कौन-सा विलयन 'प्रबल अम्ल' (Strong Acid) है?
- *Correct Answer*: **A** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q10 [bpsc-tre-general-science-social-science | ID: bpsc-tre-general-science-social-science-0010]**
- (EN): An emergency patient requires an immediate blood transfusion without prior cross-matching. Which blood group can be safely transfused as the Universal Donor?
- (HI): आपातकालीन स्थिति में किसी घायल मरीज को बिना रक्त समूह मिलान किए तुरंत किस रक्त समूह का रक्त सुरक्षित रूप से चढ़ाया जा सकता है (सर्वदाता रक्त समूह)?
- *Correct Answer*: **B** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q11 [bpsc-tre-general-science-social-science | ID: bpsc-tre-general-science-social-science-0011]**
- (EN): Under Part IV (Directive Principles of State Policy) of the Indian Constitution, which Article directs the State to secure for all citizens a Uniform Civil Code (UCC) throughout the territory of India?
- (HI): भारतीय संविधान के भाग IV (राज्य के नीति निदेशक तत्व) का कौन-सा अनुच्छेद राज्य को संपूर्ण भारत में नागरिकों के लिए 'समान नागरिक संहिता' (Uniform Civil Code - UCC) लागू करने का निर्देश देता है?
- *Correct Answer*: **C** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q12 [bpsc-tre-general-science-social-science | ID: bpsc-tre-general-science-social-science-0012]**
- (EN): The historic Hirakud Dam, the longest earthen dam in India built after independence, is constructed across which major river in Odisha?
- (HI): स्वतंत्रता के पश्चात निर्मित भारत का सबसे लंबा मिट्टी का बांध 'हीराकुंड बांध' (Hirakud Dam) ओडिशा में किस प्रमुख नदी पर स्थित है?
- *Correct Answer*: **D** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q13 [bpsc-tre-general-science-social-science | ID: bpsc-tre-general-science-social-science-0013]**
- (EN): In the revised Bloom's Taxonomy of educational objectives (Anderson & Krathwohl 2001), which cognitive process represents the highest and most complex level of thinking?
- (HI): एंडरसन और क्रैथवोहल (2001) द्वारा संशोधित ब्लूम के शैक्षिक उद्देश्यों के संज्ञानात्मक क्षेत्र में चिंतन का सर्वोच्च और सबसे जटिल स्तर कौन-सा है?
- *Correct Answer*: **A** | *Marks*: 1.0

**Q14 [bpsc-tre-general-science-social-science | ID: bpsc-tre-general-science-social-science-0014]**
- (EN): When a rocket accelerates upward into space, its propulsion is an direct application of which fundamental law of classical mechanics?
- (HI): जब कोई रॉकेट अत्यधिक वेग से अंतरिक्ष की ओर प्रक्षेपित होता है, तो उसका प्रणोदन (Propulsion) क्लासिकल भौतिकी के किस मौलिक नियम का प्रत्यक्ष अनुप्रयोग है?
- *Correct Answer*: **B** | *Marks*: 1.0
